model_name: Stage 2 MDRC-AGA Framework (Fold-Tangent + Non-Overlapping 7B + Group-Safe Block-Weighting + Calibrated Stacker)

architecture_clarification.selection_mechanism: 3-block scalar weighting via MultiScaleBlockAGA (all 1,695 dims remain active; NOT feature elimination).
architecture_clarification.stacker_vs_voter: CalibratedManifoldStacker produces OOF multinomial Platt-calibrated probabilities; MultiMetricSoftVotingClassifier produces un-calibrated heuristic [3:2:1:1] neighbor vote fractions.

block_disjoint_primary.protocol_description: Nested 5-Fold Class-Stratified Block-Disjoint CV over 328 blocks (N_ref=3,936). Fold 0 = 20% locked block holdout.

exploratory_chunk_secondary.leakage_disclosure: EXPLORATORY ONLY — overlapping 1s windows (48-sample / 37.5% overlap inside 8s blocks) share temporal context across train/test splits and Mendeley EEGIS omits participant IDs. Do not interpret as unseen-subject or block-independent generalization.

offline_demo_9_test_signals.note: Small 9-sample offline format demo ONLY (all 108 sibling chunks of the 9 source blocks excluded from training N_ref=3,936).

latency_breakdown.note: Offline per-128-sample-CSV-epoch timing on workstation CPU (NOT end-to-end streaming hardware acquisition/DAC loop).
